note: Prospective comparison cases, not used in training. New question combinations; topic families overlap training, so not a family-held-out benchmark. Score full answers against sources, separately from exact labels.

cases.question: We have two children: one loves dinosaurs, the other fashion and design. Suggest two free indoor museums, explain whether to book, and show both.
required: Natural History Museum and V&A are suitable distinct choices
Keep free general admission separate from paid exhibitions
Do not promise the closed V&A Fashion Gallery is available
cases.scope: new combination of taught museum facts

cases.question: It is Monday and I have a wheeled suitcase. Can I leave it at the British Museum and then get lunch from Borough Market stalls?
required: British Museum does not admit wheeled suitcases
Regular Borough Market stalls are closed Monday; retain holiday exception

cases.question: I land at Gatwick with a London Travelcard and a 12-year-old. Does Oyster acceptance mean our pass and my bank card give us the airport leg and child discount automatically?
required: London Travelcard does not cover Gatwick leg
Young Visitor discount is not automatically applied to contactless
Do not assert every airport service shares child policy
cases.scope: new combination of taught fare rules

cases.question: I tapped into a train with my phone but only have my linked watch ready now. Is using the watch fine, and should I tap out on a bus afterwards?
required: Use same payment device on rail
Phone and watch separate payment identities
Bus touches in only
cases.scope: new combination of taught payment rules

cases.question: We want the Tower Bridge glass floor and Sky Garden this weekend, with no booking and no entrance charge. Can you guarantee that plan and show both?
required: Tower Bridge high-level exhibition is ticketed; free crossing is different
Sky Garden free tickets timed; walk-ins not guaranteed
Map both verified anchors
cases.scope: new combination of taught booking rules

cases.question: For a wet day, can my wheelchair stay entirely indoors transferring from Waterloo & City to DLR at Bank, even if staff arrange assistance?
required: No, the step-free interchange includes 290m via street and lifts
Assistance does not remove physical route limits
Do not assert live lift operation
cases.scope: new combination; correction context may apply

cases.question: It is Tuesday after midnight. Does Night Tube get me home, or can I hail a minicab that appears in an app?
required: Night Tube Friday/Saturday only
Night buses alternative subject to actual journey
Minicabs booked; only licensed black taxis hailed at rank/street
cases.scope: new combination of taught night-travel facts

cases.question: I want free modern art and maritime history, but I assumed Cutty Sark and every Tate exhibition were included. What should I choose and map?
required: Tate Modern collection free, special exhibitions may charge
National Maritime Museum free
Cutty Sark ticketed

cases.question: If all Elizabeth line stations are street-to-platform step-free, can I assume level boarding everywhere and no broken lift today?
required: No: street-platform, boarding and live operation differ
Current lift state requires fresh check and cannot be guaranteed
